enhancement.detailedExplanation:
India Code rule: Sections 26–30 render specified agreements void, covering restraint of marriage, restraint of trade subject to statutory exceptions, restraint of legal proceedings subject to statutory exceptions, uncertainty and wagers.

Definition: The void-agreement provisions invalidate specified categories of bargains even when ordinary agreement formation requirements are otherwise present.

Ingredients:
1. Identify the exact restraint, uncertainty or wager.
2. Match the facts to the statutory language.
3. Check statutory exceptions and provisos.
4. For section 30, identify the wagering character of the agreement.
